card.name: Mixed points inside label phrases
card.fires_on: Scattered words in drug-label text, often the word just before a verb or negation (may, not, do) or partway through a name such as Child-Pugh, CABG or CYP3A4. No single word class unifies them.

modes.description: Small words like may, not, do or a that come right before the main claim in a label sentence.
